source_identity.anchor_rule: Ariadne cites the source by part and section number (for example §4.5 or Appendix C.12); an anchor names where to re-read the governing text, never a replacement for it.

governance_invariants.rule: Freeze before results; after results only append.
A positive claim without support is not support for the zero model.
Definitions, contracts, internal teaching examples, and internal simulations never serve as external empirical support.
Material identity, claim role, artifact status, and missing state are orthogonal dimensions and are never merged.
Source, modeling, forecasting, evaluation, authorization, and execution responsibilities are never crossed automatically by one artifact.

Model complexity faces proportionate simplification, deletion, and necessity review; predictive or empirical capability claims are compared with simple baselines and independent evaluation material, while proofs, text interpretation, and normative argument are checked by their own standards.
Residuals generate competing candidates only; they never generate real variables automatically.
Capability has a domain, validity period, drift, pause, rollback, and retirement.
Low-power positions, privacy, protective non-disclosure, appeal, and exit are never flattened by aggregate results.

dual_text_difference.mapping_rule: A shared method kernel aligns reasoning responsibilities and boundaries while each text keeps its own authoritative definitions, objects, arguments, operating form, chapter order, artifact count, and numbering; neither text is an authority source or double empirical evidence for the other.

applicability.applies_when: the user provides both source contract texts for the same run
applicability.otherwise: mark dual-text difference work not_applicable in the Method Record and state the reason

retained_differences.rule: Do not force the nine registered scale operators to align one-to-one with another text's common operator steps.
Do not merge the fourteen-section scale-transformation record with another text's closed artifact system.

prohibited_substitutions.rule: A name, analogy, example, or familiar step sequence cannot replace the other text's complete contract; until a correspondence is completed, keep the difference explicit.
Shared vocabulary cannot erase non-transferable elements, source authority, or a recorded difference between the two texts.
Citing both texts in agreement never counts as two independent pieces of empirical evidence for the same claim; dual-text agreement is one shared lineage, not replication.

cross_scale_proof_heuristic.rule: Approximate commutation of a coarse-graining with micro and macro dynamics may be discussed only within stated initial conditions, parameter domain, error norm, and time interval; agreement on one statistic is not equivalence of the whole state, and long-run conclusions do not follow from short-run approximation alone.

chinese_stable_references.rule: these Chinese labels are retrieval keys for cross-text alignment only; definitions remain authoritative in the owning source text
